name: autopilot
description: Project-independent autonomous-dev commands (/autodev, /autoship, /autopilot). Requires a one-time /init per repo (verifies/installs gstack, bootstraps DESIGN.md + baseline docs, writes .claude/autopilot.init.json). Project facts live in a committed .claude/autopilot.config.json (autodetected on first run); browser e2e can be recorded to video.
